pages.text: The Thermostatic Air Conditioner is an advanced climate station for greenhouses and cold storage. Place it inside the structure, supply power, and it will detect the connected structure and target the set temperature.
The default recipe requires Immersive Engineering. Without Immersive Engineering, the device can still be powered by another Forge Energy mod.

pages.title: Greenhouse Capacity
pages.text: $(li)Treated wood: 1.3x power, air conditioner ±5°C, station ±3°C. $()$(li)Copper: 1.2x power, air conditioner ±10°C, station ±5°C. $()$(li)Iron: 1.1x power, air conditioner ±18°C, station ±7°C. $()$(li)Stainless steel: 1.0x power, air conditioner ±70°C, station ±10°C. $()$(li)Mixed greenhouses use a weighted tier based on insulation wall counts. $()

pages.title: Operating Parameters
pages.text: The GUI adjusts the set temperature by -5, -1, +1, or +5°C. $(br2)It stores 4000000 FE, accepts up to 4096 FE/t, and starts above 25% energy. $(br2)When climate control is needed, minimum usage is 20 FE/t by default; actual usage also depends on effective space, temperature difference, and structure tier.

pages.title: Effects
pages.text: Controlled temperature affects crops, farmland, beehives, berries, and fruit trees. Breaking the device preserves its stored energy.
